verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management and cap-table platform, so in-platform 409A valuations are a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions 409A or any valuation service. The cap table data, API access and IFRS 2/US GAAP financial reporting are related features, not valuation ordering or scheduled valuation refreshes, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule
